turns.question: Of the customers who signed up in August 2026, what share had bought from us by 10 October 2026?
turns.answer: Of the 11 customers who signed up in August 2026, 4 (36 %) had placed a non-cancelled order by 10 October 2026, computed as Active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order) grouped by signup month over 1 August to 10 October 2026, divided by Signups for August; the semantic layer has no cohort metric for bought-by-a-date, so this combines two metrics. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
